versions.title: Rooftop Relay

skins.name: Crest Dash
skins.story: His hot-pink crest is the last thing the rooftop drones see before he drops three floors and vanishes into the lime-lit alleys.

skins.name: Parcel Bolt
skins.story: She has carried a thousand amber parcels across the rooftops and never lost a single one, not even with the red alarms on her heels.

skins.name: Rail Grinder
skins.story: He grinds the old tram rails between the towers on mint-lit skates, goggles pushed up so the wind can never hide the city from him.

versions.note: The runners take the city from above: a punk with a burning crest, a courier who has never lost a parcel and a skater who grinds the old rails between the towers.

versions.title: Smog District

skins.name: Smog Filter
skins.story: He runs where the air turns green, and the yellow filters on his mask are the only reason he always makes it back.

skins.name: Wire Locks
skins.story: Her hair is a bundle of fibre-optic cables, and every magenta tip blinks when she pulls another secret out of the city network.

skins.name: Iron Grin
skins.story: He lost his jaw in a street fight and forged a chrome one, and now his grin glows as hot as the furnace in his chest.

versions.note: Below the bright towers lies the smog district, and its runners glow just as hard: a scavenger who breathes through filters, a girl wired into the city network and a brawler with an iron grin.

versions.title: Overdrive Night

skins.name: Apex Rider
skins.story: Number 07 has won the Overdrive race four times, and nobody has ever seen the face behind the azure visor.

skins.name: Volt Medic
skins.story: She patches up crashed runners at full speed, and the heartbeat on her mask glows aqua for as long as theirs keeps going.

skins.name: Silent Collar
skins.story: Nobody knows who pays him; he just turns up his indigo collar, tips his hat, and the race always ends the way he planned.

versions.note: Once a year the whole city turns into a race track: a rider nobody has seen without a helmet, a medic who keeps the runners going and a silent fixer who decides how the race ends.
